newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MIM defends Mt Isa performance record.
newsitem.headline: MIM defends Mt Isa performance record.

text.p: Base metals giant MIM Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was disappointed at a state Labor parliamentarian's criticism of the group's performance in the Mount Isa region of northwestern Queensland.
"I am disappointed at the criticism of MIM's decisions for Mount Isa," MIM chief executive Nick Stump said in a statement.
Stump was replying to a letter to the group by local State Labor parliamentarian Tony McGrady that said the group had lost the confidence of the local community and employees.
"I believe that people in Mount Isa understand the need for change and the extent of the investments being made for the future," he said.
MIM has been engaged in a cost-cutting and rationalisation campaign at Mount Isa, its keystone base metal operation, for some years.
